name: Dresium
author: dresium

sections.description:
Transform your fashion e-commerce with AI-powered Virtual Try-On technology. Dresium lets customers upload their photo and instantly see themselves wearing your products – driving higher conversions and fewer returns.

Proven Business Results

  • +25% Conversion Rate – Customers who try on items virtually are more likely to buy
  • -30% Return Rate – Eliminate “it doesn’t look as expected” returns
  • +40% Time on Page – Interactive experience keeps shoppers engaged
  • +15% Average Cart Value – Confident customers buy more

Key Features

  • Virtual Try-On: Customers upload a photo and see themselves wearing your products
  • AI-Powered: Advanced artificial intelligence generates realistic try-on images
  • WooCommerce Integration: Seamlessly integrates with product pages
  • Secure Authentication: OAuth2/OpenID Connect for secure user sessions
  • Credits System: Flexible pay-per-use credit system
  • Analytics Dashboard: Track generations, conversions, and revenue attribution
  • Page Builder Support: Works with Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Oxygen, and Bricks

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.6 or higher
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • SSL/HTTPS recommended

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Accept the Data Processing Agreement (DPA) – required for GDPR compliance
  3. Connect your store to Dresium (free registration via OAuth2)
  4. Select which product categories enable Virtual Try-On
  5. A “Try it on” button appears on product pages
  6. Customers upload a photo and see AI-generated try-on images

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on the following external services:

Dresium API (Virtual Try-On Service)

  • Service Provider: Dresium / EasyAdv S.r.l.
  • Purpose: AI-powered virtual try-on image generation
  • When data is sent: Each time a customer clicks “Try it on” and uploads a photo
  • Data transmitted: Customer photo (for AI processing), product images (for overlay generation)
  • Data handling: Photos are processed in real-time and not permanently stored unless the customer explicitly saves them to their personal gallery. Photos are never shared with third parties or used for AI training. Dresium acts as data processor and uses the AI services listed below as sub-processors.
  • Data Processing Agreement: Merchants must accept a DPA before using the service, establishing Dresium as data processor under GDPR Article 28.
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy
  • Data Processing Agreement

Gemini AI by Google (AI Sub-Processor)

  • Service Provider: Google LLC
  • Purpose: AI image generation for virtual try-on processing
  • When data is sent: When Dresium API processes a virtual try-on request, it may route image generation to Gemini AI
  • Data transmitted: Customer photos and product images are transmitted via Dresium servers to Google for AI processing
  • Data handling: Data is processed by Google solely for image generation. Dresium maintains data processor responsibilities.
  • Gemini API Terms of Service
  • Google Privacy Policy

Grok AI by xAI (AI Sub-Processor)

  • Service Provider: xAI Corp.
  • Purpose: AI image and video generation for virtual try-on processing
  • When data is sent: When Dresium API processes a virtual try-on request, it may route image or video generation to Grok AI
  • Data transmitted: Customer photos and product images are transmitted via Dresium servers to xAI for AI processing
  • Data handling: Data is processed by xAI solely for image and video generation. Dresium maintains data processor responsibilities.
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

Claude AI by Anthropic (AI Sub-Processor)

  • Service Provider: Anthropic PBC
  • Purpose: AI-powered customer support agent
  • When data is sent: When a user interacts with the Dresium support chatbot
  • Data transmitted: Chat messages and conversation context are transmitted to Anthropic for response generation
  • Data handling: Data is processed by Anthropic solely for customer support purposes. No customer photos are sent to this service.
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

WhatsApp Sharing (Social Sharing Feature)

  • Service Provider: WhatsApp LLC (Meta Platforms, Inc.)
  • Purpose: Allow users to share their virtual try-on results via WhatsApp
  • When data is sent: Only when a user explicitly clicks the “Share on WhatsApp” button
  • Data transmitted: A sharing URL is opened via the WhatsApp API (api.whatsapp.com) – no image data is sent directly, only a link to the shared page
  • WhatsApp Terms of Service
  • WhatsApp Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Dresium”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Dresium to connect your store
sections.faq:
Do I need a Dresium account?

The plugin automatically creates a connection when you first activate it. No separate account registration is required – simply click “Connect to Dresium” in the plugin settings.

Does it work with any theme?

Dresium is designed to work with most WooCommerce themes. It includes automatic detection for popular page builders including Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Oxygen, and Bricks.

How do credits work?

Each AI generation consumes one credit. New users receive free credits to try the service. Additional credits can be purchased directly within the plugin.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes, Dresium is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

What types of products work best?

Dresium works best with clothing items such as t-shirts, shirts, jackets, dresses, pants, and hoodies. It is optimized for fashion products.

How are customer photos handled?

Photos are securely transmitted to Dresium servers for AI processing. They are not permanently stored unless the customer explicitly saves them to their personal gallery. Photos are never shared with third parties or used for AI training.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes, Dresium is designed with GDPR compliance in mind. Before using the service, merchants must accept a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) that establishes Dresium as data processor under GDPR Article 28. Users can delete their photos and data at any time. Full details are available in our privacy policy and DPA.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org
  • Full WooCommerce integration with product page button
  • Secure OAuth2/OpenID Connect authentication
  • Support for page builders (Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Oxygen, Bricks)
  • Built-in analytics dashboard for tracking generations and conversions
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility
  • Multi-language support with translations ready
  • GDPR-compliant photo handling
